title: Presentation independence of determinantal ideals
statement: Let R be a commutative ring and M an R-module whose additive group is commutative. Let n,p,n′,p′ be natural numbers, P an n-by-p matrix and Q an n′-by-p′ matrix over R, and let π:R^n→M and π′:R^{n′}→M be surjective R-linear maps with ker(π)=im(P) and ker(π′)=im(Q). For every natural number r, the ideal generated by the (n−r)-minors of P equals the ideal generated by the (n′−r)-minors of Q. Subtraction is truncated at zero; minors use injective row and column selections, the empty determinant is 1, and an unavailable positive size generates the zero ideal.
lean_statement: ∀ {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (n p n' p' : ℕ) (P : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin p) R) (Q : Matrix (Fin n') (Fin p') R) (π : (Fin n → R) →ₗ[R] M) (π' : (Fin n' → R) →ₗ[R] M) (_hπ : Function.Surjective π) (_hker : LinearMap.ker π = LinearMap.range P.mulVecLin) (_hπ' : Function.Surjective π') (_hker' : LinearMap.ker π' = LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin) (r : ℕ), (Ideal.span {x : R | ∃ (rows : Fin (n - r) ↪ Fin n) (cols : Fin (n - r) ↪ Fin p), x = Matrix.det (P.submatrix rows cols)}) = Ideal.span {x : R | ∃ (rows : Fin (n' - r) ↪ Fin n') (cols : Fin (n' - r) ↪ Fin p'), x = Matrix.det (Q.submatrix rows cols)}
